component_hierarchy.features: Glassmorphic bar with announcement ribbon, category flyout menu, live cart sheet trigger with item count pill, PIN code delivery checker modal, and customer account quick-link.
React Three Fiber canvas + Drei Float & OrbitControls, 4 separable mattress layers with entrance bounce, layer inspect button, zone heatmap toggle, and fallback 2D view.
Interactive 7-zone body pressure map with SVG silhouette, keyboard/hover trigger, zone firmness statistics, and mobile-friendly tab carousel.
4-step farm-to-bedroom storytelling (Tree Tapping, Centrifugation, Dunlop Baking, GOTS Quilting) with rich photography and botanical badges.
GOLS, GOTS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, and eco-INSTITUT verifiable certificate modal previews + Shark Tank India featured reel placeholder.
High-density editorial product card with trial badge, star rating, instant size pill selector, INR price with discount math, and quick add-to-cart button.
Multi-dimensional variant picker (Size, Thickness, Firmness) dynamically updating price, SKU, delivery ETA, and stock status.
Side sheet with free shipping progress bar (Unlock free organic pillow above ₹35,000), item quantity controls, trial period notice, and Razorpay-ready checkout CTA.
Shared back-office shell with role switcher tab (Admin / Manager / CRM / Dealer), dark-mode sidebar, search bar, and toast notification listener.

rules: Use staggered fade-in + translateY(12px) on product grids (0.05s stagger)
3D layer assembly uses spring physics: stiffness 120, damping 14
Hover effects use explicit transform with transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
Interactive zone selector highlights corresponding body segment with soft green glow
Respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion's useReducedMotion hook

accessibility_and_compliance.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px for all buttons, pills, and dropdown triggers
accessibility_and_compliance.focus_states: Visible 2px ring with 2px offset: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#467065] focus-visible:ring-offset-2
accessibility_and_compliance.contrast_guarantee: Text against #FAF8F5 is #2D2D2D (ratio 12.8:1); muted text #5C6656 (ratio 5.1:1); on brand #467065 text is #FFFFFF (ratio 5.4:1)
accessibility_and_compliance.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements have kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='hero-explore-btn', data-testid='add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='zone-select-lumbar', data-testid='checkout-pay-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.css theme tokens with the provided brand leaf (#7C9C59), brand deep (#467065), and charcoal (#2D2D2D) tokens and import Outfit, DM Sans, and JetBrains Mono.
2. Keep currency strictly INR with ₹ symbol and Indian numbering format (e.g. ₹29,999).
3. Build the 3D hero with @react-three/fiber + @react-three/drei using procedural rounded slabs and lighting, paired with the static/reduced-motion fallback.
4. Implement the 7-zone interactive selector with active state synchronization to the body anatomical diagram.
5. Ensure the Razorpay checkout shows the test-mode badge and handles both simulated and active gateway modes gracefully.
6. Build all 4 back-office consoles (/admin, /manager, /crm, /dealer) with role-based mock switching so any role can be previewed seamlessly.
7. Mount Sonner's <Toaster /> at bottom-right in App.tsx or main layout.
